tasks.title: Prepare sprint review
tasks.description: Summarize completed work, blockers, and next steps for the team. Include a short recap of what shipped, what is still at risk, and what the team should focus on during the next iteration.

subtasks.title: Collect sprint metrics
subtasks.description: Gather velocity, bug count, and completed story points.

subtasks.title: Prepare blockers list
subtasks.description: List dependency risks and unresolved issues from the sprint.

tasks.title: Buy groceries
tasks.description: Pick up vegetables, milk, bread, and a few pantry staples for the week. Make sure to check the fridge inventory before going so the list stays short and practical.

subtasks.title: Check pantry
subtasks.description: Avoid buying duplicates by reviewing what is already available.

subtasks.title: Create shopping list
subtasks.description: Write the final list based on the pantry review and weekly needs.

tasks.title: Client onboarding call
tasks.description: Walk the new client through the initial setup steps and answer questions about onboarding, access, and rollout expectations. Keep notes about feature priorities and any blockers that need follow-up after the call.

subtasks.title: Prepare agenda
subtasks.description: Share a short agenda before the call so the client knows what to expect.

subtasks.title: Collect account details
subtasks.description: Verify team contacts, company info, and access requirements.

tasks.title: Fix login bug
tasks.description: Investigate the password reset issue reported by QA and reproduce it locally before implementing a fix. Review the recent authentication changes and confirm whether the regression is caused by the new flow or a missing validation rule.

subtasks.title: Reproduce issue
subtasks.description: Test the reset flow and confirm the exact broken case.

subtasks.title: Patch auth flow
subtasks.description: Implement the fix and validate the regression test.

tasks.title: Plan weekend trip
tasks.description: Research destinations, compare accommodation options, and create a rough shortlist for the weekend trip. Include travel time, estimated cost, and a few backup options in case the first choice is unavailable.

subtasks.title: Compare destinations
subtasks.description: Review weather, price, and travel distance for the top options.

subtasks.title: Pick backup option
subtasks.description: Choose a fallback destination in case the first choice gets booked.

tasks.title: Write project proposal
tasks.description: Draft the main proposal sections, budget estimate, and delivery assumptions. Expand the narrative around outcomes, expected effort, and the timeline so the proposal reads as a complete package.

subtasks.title: Gather requirements
subtasks.description: Collect client expectations and key project constraints.

subtasks.title: Draft budget estimate
subtasks.description: Prepare a first-pass estimate for the proposal budget.

tasks.title: Review PR comments
tasks.description: Check feedback on the latest pull request and respond to each comment with a clear action plan. Make sure to verify whether any suggestions should be implemented now or deferred to a follow-up task.

subtasks.title: Open PR discussion
subtasks.description: Review each reviewer comment before drafting replies.

subtasks.title: Reply to comments
subtasks.description: Draft replies and note which comments need implementation.

tasks.title: Prepare dinner for guests
tasks.description: Cook a simple menu for the evening gathering and make sure the preparation timeline fits the arrival time. Keep the menu easy to execute while still feeling generous and pleasant for the guests.

subtasks.title: Buy ingredients
subtasks.description: Pick up the ingredients needed for the planned menu.

subtasks.title: Prep the kitchen
subtasks.description: Set up the cooking space and portion the ingredients before guests arrive.

tasks.title: Send follow-up email
tasks.description: Send the client a recap and next-step summary after the latest call. Include a concise summary of the discussion, the next scheduled action, and any outstanding questions.

subtasks.title: Draft message
subtasks.description: Write a concise email with the follow-up details.

subtasks.title: Send email
subtasks.description: Send the final follow-up message to the client.

tasks.title: Deploy hotfix
tasks.description: Release the urgent fix to production after validation and confirm that the deployment completed successfully. Document the release window, impacted services, and any rollback steps to keep the process safe.

subtasks.title: Validate deployment
subtasks.description: Confirm the release is healthy and no regressions appeared.

subtasks.title: Share release notes
subtasks.description: Send deployment notes to the team and stakeholders.
